cohort: The study included 356 mothers and their corresponding newborns from hospitals in the Southwest Shoa Zone, Central Ethiopia.
finding: The magnitude of neonatal near-miss was 29.2%, with pregnancy-induced hypertension, non-vertex presentation, antepartum hemorrhage, premature rupture of membrane, inadequate prenatal care visit, and cesarean section delivery identified as significant predictors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was found to be a significant predictor of neonatal near-miss (AOR = 2.96; 1.28, 3.87).
